title: BUSINESS_LOGIC: Verify server rejects client-manipulated $1.00 fare for a $590.00 ticket.
financial_summary: High financial loss: Server confirms booking using arbitrary client-submitted price.

title: BUSINESS_LOGIC: Verify duplicate cancellation requests do not issue multiple refund payouts.
financial_summary: Duplicate payout risk: Concurrent or sequential cancellation emits multiple cash refunds.
remediation_guide: In routes/cancel.py, enforce strict state machine locking. If booking.status == 'CANCELLED', reject subsequent requests with 400 Bad Request.
